en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a tranquil canal lined with traditional wooden buildings on both sides. The canal leads towards a small bridge in the distance, with trees and rooftops visible beyond. The water is still, reflecting the buildings and sky above. A small boat is partly visible in the lower right corner. The text on the postcard is in Swedish, and the overall style suggests a vintage period.
